releaseNotes:
• Fix: Rebuilt MobileCLIP prompts (6 positive, 17 negative) so shirtless night fights, shirtless injured/lone frames, dark hugs, morgue/hospital beds, and close suspense dialogue score negatively instead of false-skipping.
• Fix: Stopped single-frame MobileCLIP false-skip spikes on dark/1-face frames (requires clipMargin >= 0.038f for instant skip; borderline frames require 2 consecutive confirming scans).
• Includes all v4.0 / v4.1 Hybrid Community Timestamp Skip features.
